method: Six complete native rich-message bodies (593instructions), actual glyph-width and decimal helpers versus handwritten C; full state/line/link buffers, ordered sprite arguments, consumed metric returns, WORD colors, native stack/saved registers. Pixel cases compose actual native/C sprite dispatch, clipping and raw copies and compare full framebuffer bytes including padded rows.
limitations: Raw glyph fixtures use controlled5x7 deterministic sprite pixels and actual immutable character map; asset identity and compressed sprites are separate proofs. Sprite endpoint is controlled in nonpixel cases to test consumed metadata reloads and deep side effects.

Native unchecked text copies require assembled lines to fit the200byte scratch buffer and linked IDs/font image records to be valid. Numeric link markers require their native following delimiter/text; an isolated marker immediately at NUL makes the original scanner consume beyond that NUL and is excluded. Word/line budget guards are exercised separately without overflowing the native scratch buffer. Negative image indices are outside the valid font domain; no new production guard is inserted.

The existing read-only glyph measurement and decimal parser are composed. Native decimal input remains within its power-table capacity; tests include signed32bit bounds. Windows32bit compiled arithmetic is compared, with explicit unsigned wrap in the rewritten six bodies.
Completed city rendering, actual font payload identity and other downstream renderer paths require root integration replay.

terminal_marker_native_audit.explanation: The numeric link has no following delimiter/text. Native scanner consumes its NUL inside markup and then scans following90guard bytes; layout retries the oversized token. C preserves that behavior and completes its999line guard; bounded native observation is retained separately and does not assert complete equivalence. Actual MM terminal numeric selectors occur only media field60; no such markers occur in title/caption/body fields.

smoke.output: Rich message text: measurement, hyperlink, typed counters and glyph metrics passed.
